items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know we did one that involved Charlie Mingus.

ctx.x: We look at the…You did…How many dates did you do with the Jones brothers?

Not very many, unfortunately. I know we did one that involved Charlie Mingus. We did another one. I think there were only two altogether. That is ridiculous because I think we should have done 50 or 60. We were all going divergent ways. Everyone was going this way, I was going that way, and they were going this way.
The Mingus date, was it Thad’s date on Debut.
